articles.title: Another Trump memecoin dinner advertised for token's top investors

articles.title: NEAR Intents says it’s identified the hacker, gives 48-hour ultimatum
articles.snippet: “We have identified you, sir,” NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said on Friday after the protocol was hacked for $3.8 million.
